news.headline:
Diageo India (United Spirits) became India's largest liquor firm in FY26 with ₹28,294 crore income, overtaking Pernod Ricard.

Radico Khaitan ranked third with total income surging 22.7% to ₹20,976.4 crore, followed by United Breweries and Allied Blenders.

Source: NDTV Profit

news.headline:
PNB may require around ₹5,000 crore additional provision for RBI's ECL framework migration from April 1, 2027.

MD Ashok Chandra affirmed the transition will not significantly impact the bank's profitability or capital position.

Source: Business Standard

Billwin Industries reported H1 net profit of Rs 9.6 lakh on revenue of Rs 205.4 lakh, declining YoY.

Auditors raised concerns over unconfirmed long-pending trade receivables of Rs 678.7 lakh and payables of Rs 173.8 lakh.

Source: BSE

news.headline:
Davangere Sugar's board will meet on November 26, 2026, to consider revising the conversion price of outstanding FCCBs.

Trading window for designated persons is closed from November 21, 2026, until 48 hours after the board meeting.

Source: BSE
